name: St. Joseph County
notes: County seat and county offices are in South Bend. Executive = three-member Board of Commissioners; fiscal body = nine-member County Council.

name: St. Joseph County courts (Circuit, Probate, Superior)
notes: Circuit and Probate judges are elected; Superior Court judges are chosen by merit selection and face retention votes.

name: City of South Bend
notes: Second-class-city structure (6 district + 3 at-large council seats; IC 36-4-6-3). The 'second class' label itself was not directly confirmed in research; fact-check treats it as consistent with statute band.

name: City of Mishawaka
notes: Mayor-council city; 9-member Common Council (6 district + 3 at-large) and elected City Clerk.

name: Town of Indian Village
notes: Incorporated town in Clay Township (population 118 in the 2020 census, per Wikipedia). State Board of Accounts reports name a Clerk-Treasurer (Suzette Jozwiak, 2012-2019) and Town Council President (Geraldine Oppenheim, 2013-2018); council size, current officers and election results were not found, and the town does not appear in the county canvasses reviewed.

name: Town of Lakeville
notes: Three-member town council (President Lori Kelly, Vice President April Hathaway, Board Member Dean Rouch) and Clerk-Treasurer Nicole Carr per town-published October 2026 minutes. Appeared on the 2011 and 2015 canvasses; no later contested races found.

name: Town of New Carlisle
notes: Five-member council (staggered: two seats end 2026, three end 2027) and a Clerk-Treasurer, per the town's own pages. Canvass vote-for numbers vary by year with the seats up.

name: Town of North Liberty
notes: Five-member town council and a Clerk-Treasurer per town minutes (Dec 2025, Sept 2026). Appears in the 2026 canvass (at-large council, two candidates).

name: Town of Osceola
notes: Clerk-Treasurer plus council (wards in 2019; at-large in 2023).

name: Town of Roseland
notes: Clerk-Treasurer plus at-large council.

name: Town of Walkerton
notes: Clerk-Treasurer, Town Judge, four wards plus at-large council.

name: South Bend Community School Corporation
notes: Seven-member board (5 district + 2 at-large per research; a 2016 canvass transcription shows 3 at-large winners; seat count conflict unresolved).

name: Penn-Harris-Madison School Corporation
places_covered: Penn, Harris and Madison townships (per Wikipedia)
notes: Board seats elected at-large and from Harris, Madison and Penn townships; seat counts per township not fully determined.

name: School City of Mishawaka
notes: Five trustees: three elected at-large plus two appointed (one by the Common Council, one by the mayor), per research.

name: John Glenn School Corporation
notes: Township seats as printed on the county canvass: Johnson, Liberty, Lincoln, Polk.

name: LaVille Community Schools (formerly Union-North United School Corporation)
notes: Renamed LaVille Community Schools: the board's June 9, 2025 agenda carried the renaming as an action item (BoardDocs), matching the Pilot News report of a June 2025 decision. Wikipedia gives June 8, 2026; that meeting's related item was not read. The 2026 canvass lists its seats as "LaVille schools". Covers Union Township (St. Joseph County, including Lakeville) and North Township (Marshall County, including La Paz). Five-member elected board. Seats: North Township, Union Township, at-large.

name: New Prairie United School Corporation
notes: Appears on the St. Joseph County canvass (at-large and districts 1-3); research notes the corporation is LaPorte County based (not confirmed).

name: St. Joseph County Public Library
notes: Seven-member appointed board (not elected); trustees serve four-year terms. Taxing detail not verified in sources.

name: Mishawaka-Penn-Harris Public Library
notes: Seven-member appointed board; appointers listed in appointed_boards.csv.

name: South Bend Public Transportation Corporation (Transpo)
notes: Appointing detail and levy not found in research.

name: St. Joseph County Airport Authority (South Bend International Airport)
